author: A Google user
review_text: Nice App... I am from Dhangadhi. I am unable to use all the feature of esewa like khanepani ( Counter not added yet ) and Bus Service ( Not added yet ). Due to this I reduced 2 star. Also it is difficult to search the option we are looking for. There should be option like personalize home page according to user so that every user can personalize their homepage according to them. Thank You

author: A Google user
review_text: Firstly, I was never notified of transaction limit when I created new account. Tried to buy flight tickets in the last minute and now suddenly I have limits? Had to call them to lift the limit. Secondly, I was never told bank transfer costs money. Transferred Rs.100 to a friend to split a bill and got hit with Rs. 10 fee. Still not sure if it's flat Rs. 10 or 10% charge to do so. Lack of communication at it's finest.

review_text: eSewa made many payments easier. I like it. Previously it doesn't charge for payment transfer among eSewa users. But now it started charging. Transfers among the users should made free of cost.
